title: Daily Supertrend (ATR 10, x3) long-only flip trend follower
rule_summary: Daily signals from closed daily candles built from the 1h data, executed at the next 1h open. Compute ATR(10) on daily candles (Wilder smoothing). Basic bands: hl2 +/- 3.0 * ATR. Final lower band only ratchets up while the close stays above it and resets when price closes below it; the Supertrend line is the final lower band in an uptrend and the final upper band in a downtrend. ENTRY: the daily close crosses from below to above the Supertrend line (trend flips to up) and no position is open. EXIT: the daily close crosses below the Supertrend line (trend flips to down); the line itself acts as a trailing stop. No other filters, no take-profit, no fixed stop. Long only, whole balance, one position per pair.
mechanism: Trend followers who trade a volatility-scaled trailing stop profit from slow information diffusion and herding in crypto: large moves tend to continue, while the ATR-scaled trail cuts losers. The other side is late mean-reversion sellers and traders who fade breakouts. The source gives no mechanism beyond the technical description, so this is the closest honest one.
